entities.summary: The Goaldi Mosque is a mosque in the historic Bengali capital of Sonargaon, in Narayanganj District, in the Dhaka Division of Bangladesh. The Sultanate period mosque was built during the reign of Sultan Alauddin Hussain Shah in 925 A.H./1519 AD. It is one of the few surviving medieval monuments in Sonargaon Upazila.
